items.markdown:
A closed-ended question in research `limits respondents to a fixed, predefined set of answer choices rather than allowing open text or free-form explanations`.[[1]](https://www.sogolytics.com/learning-center/survey-questionnaire/close-ended-questions-guide-benefits-examples/)

### Key Characteristics

- **Predefined Options:** Choices usually include checkboxes, radio buttons, or dropdown lists.
- **Quantitative Data:** Yields numerical or categorical data that can be quickly analyzed using statistics.
- **Standardization:** Every participant sees the exact same choices, which ensures consistency and objective measurement.[[1]](https://www.questionpro.com/close-ended-questions.html)[[2]](https://www.appinio.com/en/blog/market-research/close-ended-questions)[[3]](https://www.sogolytics.com/learning-center/survey-questionnaire/close-ended-questions-guide-benefits-examples/)

### Common Types

- **Dichotomous:** Offers two mutually exclusive choices (e.g., Yes/No, True/False).
- **Multiple Choice:** Provides a list of specific categories where one or more options can be selected.
- **Rating & Likert Scales:** Measures intensity, agreement, or satisfaction on a numbered continuum (e.g., 1 to 5).
- **Rank Order:** Asks respondents to sort items by preference or priority.[[1]](https://methods.sagepub.com/ency/edvol/encyclopedia-of-survey-research-methods/chpt/closedended-question)[[2]](https://www.questionpro.com/close-ended-questions.html)[[3]](https://www.sogolytics.com/learning-center/survey-questionnaire/close-ended-questions-guide-benefits-examples/)[[4]](https://casrai.org/guides/closed-ended-questions-in-research)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zOrBu8CpSVs&t=16)

### Pros and Cons

- **Advantages:** Fast for participants to complete (leading to higher response rates), easy to code, and simple to compare across large sample groups.
- **Disadvantages:** Lacks deeper context ("why" things happen) and can introduce bias if your predefined choices miss important options.[[1]](https://www.kantar.com/inspiration/research-services/close-ended-questions-pf)[[2]](https://www.appinio.com/en/blog/market-research/close-ended-questions)[[3]](https://www.sogolytics.com/learning-center/survey-questionnaire/close-ended-questions-guide-benefits-examples/)

For a deeper dive into survey methodology, check out the [Sage Research Methods Encyclopedia](https://methods.sagepub.com/ency/edvol/encyclopedia-of-survey-research-methods/chpt/closedended-question) or review [QuestionPro's Guide to Close-Ended Questions](https://www.questionpro.com/close-ended-questions.html).[[1]](https://methods.sagepub.com/ency/edvol/encyclopedia-of-survey-research-methods/chpt/closedended-question)[[2]](https://www.questionpro.com/close-ended-questions.html)If you are designing a survey, let me know:
